---
title: "Downloads"
---

Educational PDFs and bedside resources.

```{ojs}
downloadsData = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    let textItems = [];
    let resources = [];
    const emit = () => notify({ textItems, resources });

    const unsubText = onSnapshot(collection(db, "DownloadsText"), snapshot => {
      textItems = snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data());
      emit();
    });
    const unsubResources = onSnapshot(collection(db, "Downloads"), snapshot => {
      resources = snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()).sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0));
      emit();
    });

    return () => { unsubText(); unsubResources(); };
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
overviewParagraphs = downloadsData.textItems.filter(t => t.section === "overview").sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0))
```

```{ojs}
futureDirections = downloadsData.textItems.filter(t => t.section === "futureDirections").sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0))
```

## Overview

```{ojs}
overviewParagraphs.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<div>${overviewParagraphs.map(p => `<p>${p.text}</p>`).join("")}</div>`
```

## Educational Resources

```{ojs}
downloadsData.resources.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<div class="fs-grid">${downloadsData.resources.map(r => {
      const hasWebLink = !!r.pdfURL;
      return `
        <div class="fs-card">
          <div class="fs-card-body">
            <h4 class="fs-card-title">${r.title ?? "Untitled"}</h4>
            <p class="fs-card-desc">${r.subtitle ?? ""}</p>
            ${hasWebLink
              ? `<a class="fs-card-link" href="${r.pdfURL}" target="_blank">Open PDF →</a>`
              : `<span class="fs-badge" style="background:#8e44ad;">Available in the mobile app</span>`}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join("")}</div>`
```

## Future Directions

```{ojs}
futureDirections.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<ul>${futureDirections.map(f => `<li>${f.text}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
```
